summary: Completed frontend-only footer regression testing on preview URL. All requested footer fixes validated on desktop and mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css is very large (~2200+ lines); split into section-scoped files for maintainability.
Duplicate .footer-label rules exist in App.css and rely on override order; keep one source-of-truth rule.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://micro-moments-8.preview.emergentagent.com: My Philosophy is single-line, footer heading renders exactly three lines (Visual Quality. / Brand coherence. / Audience impact.) with each span non-wrapping, increased gap from blue banner to label (~137px desktop), description visible, Behance and Email visible, and no horizontal overflow on desktop (1920x1080) or mobile (390x844).
rca of the issue: Original multi-line wrapping was caused by heading phrase wrapping and insufficient spacing above the philosophy block. Current CSS fixes (block + nowrap spans, reduced h2 clamp sizing, and increased footer header bottom margin) address the root causes.
